metadata.workload: Pillow images; encode RGB square-size, landscape/portrait, component-count, RGBA and grayscale cases; decode RGB square-size, aspect-ratio and component-count cases. The blurhash adapter uses NumPy arrays; blurhash-python receives an RGB image copy because its encoder closes RGB inputs; other modes are converted internally. Encoding preserves caller images and decoding returns RGB Pillow images.
